title: Admissions for International Degree Students (2027 September Entry)
field: All NTU bachelor's, master's and PhD programmes
about: National Taiwan University admits international degree students for September 2027 entry in two rounds. Round 2 runs 1 December 2026 to 19 January 2027, with decisions on 8 April 2027; applicants may choose up to five departments.
requirements: Round 1: 29 September - 5 November 2026 (expected to be extended because of system maintenance); Round 2: 1 December 2026 - 19 January 2027
Apply to up to five departments or graduate institutes
Fee NTD 2,000 or USD 80 per department; online applications only
card_alt: Card for Admissions for International Degree Students (2027 September Entry) at National Taiwan University (NTU), Taiwan, Round 2 deadline 19 Jan 2027.
